spec_section_updates.section_4: Cycle 9: All 4 fixes from Cycle 8 close-debate landed. CR-1 (extractDefinitions fence-aware): parseMarkdownBlock.ts:464-480 — fence-state {marker, len} tracking, isFenceCloser at line 404 (info-string-on-closer rejected), classifyOutsideFenceLine at line 419, renderer-consistent predicate `line.trim().startsWith('```' or '~~~')` at line 393. CR-2 (compact <details>): findDetailsClose scans from lineStartIndex INCLUSIVE at line 305, collectDetailsBody same-line branch at line 318, SUMMARY_LINE_RE captures inline body at line 299, extractDetailsSummary mutates bodyLines for inline form at line 343. CR-3 (sub/sup baseline): MarkdownView.tsx:527-528 — sub: { fontSize: 10, lineHeight: 14, transform: [{ translateY: 4 }] }; sup: { fontSize: 10, lineHeight: 14, transform: [{ translateY: -4 }] }. CR-4 (i18n footnote title): MarkdownInlineDecorations.tsx:42 uses t('markdown.footnoteTitle', { label }); key added to 11 files (10 langs + _default.ts). Vitest 38/38 PASS. Live DOM verification: sub `2` transform=matrix(1,0,0,1,0,4) [ty=+4], sup `2` transform=matrix(1,0,0,1,0,-4) [ty=-4], abs(delta_ty)=8. Code block in user message preserves [ref]: https://example.com verbatim. Compact <details> on own line renders as ▼ Compact summary + Compact body text. Footnote modal title localizes to '脚注 zh1' under zh-Hans. Evidence: docs/dev/evidence/20260510-090535/{qa-cycle9-desktop,qa-cycle9-desktop-live-message,qa-cycle9-mobile,qa-cycle9-footnote-modal,qa-cycle9-footnote-modal-zhHans}.png.
